events.title: Opera in the Gardens
events.location: Roma Street Parkland (Amphitheatre / Celebration Lawn), Brisbane City
events.description: A free outdoor opera concert featuring popular arias and classical favourites performed by professional soloists and an ensemble. This family-friendly, picnic-style afternoon event is part of the Council’s parks and culture program.

events.title: What the World Needs Now… (Anywhere Festival)
events.location: Private / pop‑up venue, 420 Lytton Road, Morningside
events.description: An intimate cabaret-style concert as part of the Brisbane Anywhere Festival, featuring a small ensemble and vocalists performing songs themed around connection and hope. Expect a relaxed and informal setting with limited capacity.

events.title: Three Storytellers, One Piano (Anywhere Festival)
events.description: A boutique living-room performance where three writers and performers share personal stories, accompanied by a single pianist. This Anywhere Festival event combines narrative, humour, and live music in an intimate setting.

events.title: K Mak at the Planetarium (Anywhere Festival feature event)
events.description: An immersive audiovisual performance by artist K Mak, combining cello, violin, synths, beats, and vocals with stunning full-dome planetarium visuals. This limited-capacity evening show is part of the Brisbane Anywhere Festival.

events.title: Brisbane / Meanjin Suitcase Rummage – May 17th 2026
events.description: An iconic mini-market where stallholders sell vintage, second-hand, and handmade goods directly from suitcases, running 12pm–5pm. This event also serves as a social gathering spot for local creatives, students, and thrifters.

events.title: Bank Heist Adventure – Self‑Guided City Puzzle Game
events.description: An app-based urban adventure that transforms central Brisbane into a fictional bank heist scene, where small groups follow clues and solve puzzles over 2-3 hours. Enjoy flexible start times and a unique way to explore the city.

events.title: Fiesta De Kayak – Twilight Kayak Experience
events.location: Riverlife Adventure Centre, Kangaroo Point Cliffs
events.description: A guided twilight kayak on the Brisbane River offering a lively, fiesta-style atmosphere, paddling under the Story Bridge with music and photo opportunities. Popular with small groups looking for a social, semi-adventurous evening.

events.title: Geraldine Hickey at The Princess Theatre
events.description: A stand-up comedy show by acclaimed Australian comedian Geraldine Hickey, known for her sharp, deadpan storytelling and observational humour. She performs a full solo show at Brisbane’s heritage-listed Princess Theatre.

events.title: J.I.D – God Does Like World Tour (Relocated to The Fortitude Music Hall)
events.location: The Fortitude Music Hall, Fortitude Valley
events.description: US rapper J.I.D brings his 'God Does Like World Tour' to Brisbane for an evening of high-energy performance and a full live set. The event is relocated to The Fortitude Music Hall, with doors opening around 6–7pm.
